definitions.full: H5053. nogah [ נ֫גַהּ ] noun [feminine] brightness, daylight ( ᵑ7 Syriac; Biblical Hebrew id. ); — emphatic בְּנָגְהָא (K § 54 c ), 1) Dan 6:20 .
